extracted.name: Frozen tropical fruit yogurt
extracted.description: Try this genius recipe – as if by magic, the frozen tropical fruit freezes the yogurt when blended together. Use a food processor rather than a blender
ingredient_lines: 200g diced tropical fruit and passion fruit seeds, to serve
instruction_lines: Put everything except the fresh fruit in a food processor and blend. Scoop straight into bowls, or tip into a container and freeze if you want to serve it later. Serve with the fresh tropical fruit and spoon over the passion fruit seeds.
